hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: Runs a per-pool buyback pot and optional auto-compounding LP program inside afterSwap. On each swap, it time-weights a reference tick, computes a spend allowance from the pot, executes a nested buyback swap to purchase the pool's main token, and delivers proceeds to a configured recipient or burns via the Glue Protocol. Static-fee pools only; hookData is unused.
